name: Kim Il-yeop
shortBio: Korean feminist theorist, New Woman pioneer, and Seon (Zen) Buddhist nun whose writings bridged modern existential critique of patriarchal love with Seon Buddhist psychology of the Great Self (daea).
centralQuestion: How does transcending the ego-bound small self (soa) through Seon Buddhist cultivation liberate women from patriarchal desire and existential alienation?

keyWorks.title: Reflections of a Zen Buddhist Nun (Eoneu Sudoin-ui Hoesang)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical synthesis of feminist self-determination and Korean Seon Buddhist non-duality, culture, and existential psychology.

keyWorks.title: In Search of Happiness Before Having Lost It
keyWorks.description: Meditations on consciousness, creative emptiness, and spiritual autonomy beyond conventional social roles.
